comparison.objective: Adjust and lock a robot-gripper stop versus clean an SC ferrule and latch the connector into a panel adapter.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a driver and wrench on coupled hardware; the fibre task requires a one-way contact wipe followed by contamination-free tight insertion and latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks nut retention and repeatable jaw angle; fibre scoring checks a valid wipe before insertion, no prohibited ferrule contact, and final connector latch/release.
comparison.reason: Both are AI-hardware service tasks, but industrial labels and generic precision do not erase the different tested abilities.
